subject: Hosted API evaluation — compact slot swap request
body:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari@openretail.co>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Liu <sam.liu@openretail.co>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick hosted API demo? (PLG signup)

Hi Soojin,

I signed up for the hosted API sandbox this morning and would love a short run-through to confirm how we can integrate generation + embeddings for our product recommender. I work with Sam (cc'd).

We're on Pacific time and largely available this afternoon — would a 30-minute slot between 3:30–4:30 pm PT work on your side? If you have something earlier, even better; we prefer a compact walk-through focused on integration and billing implications.

Thanks,
Ari
Ari Kaplan
Head of Product, OpenRetail
ari@openretail.co

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@openretail.co>
Cc: Sam Liu <sam.liu@openretail.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API demo? (PLG signup)

Hi Ari — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for signing up and for the context.

I can run a tight 30-minute walkthrough this afternoon. Quick options I have open: 3:30 PM PT, 4:00 PM PT, or 4:30 PM PT. If you prefer an earlier slot I can also try a 1:15 PM PT window.

If you'd like to shorten to 20 minutes (we can focus purely on the integration path and skip the billing deep-dive), say the word and I'll block the compact slot and send the sandbox invite.

Pre-read attached: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (short checklist + curl examples). I'll also attach the sandbox invite once you confirm a time.

Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30min
Sandbox preview link (no auth required): https://app.redwood.ai/sandbox/invite/OPR-0472

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin Lee
PLG Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119

Thanks — that was fast. We can do 3:30 PM PT but could you make it a 20-minute compact session? We already poked at the quickstart guide — Sam mainly wants to confirm request/response payloads and embedding shape for our catalog. 20 minutes should be perfect.

Also, we might want the recording for the rest of the team. Can you enable a meeting recording or share slides afterward?

—Ari

Confirmed: 3:30–3:50 PM PT (20 minutes) — I've sent a calendar invite (sandbox-invite.ics) and attached the short quickstart guide.

Agenda (20m compact):
- 0–3m: quick intros + desired outcomes (Ari / Sam)
- 3–12m: live hosted API demo (generation + embeddings integration pattern)
- 12–18m: quick Q&A (payload shapes, auth, rate limits)
- 18–20m: next steps + share recording/slides

Recording: I'll record the session and upload the link after the meeting. If you prefer not to be recorded let me know and I won't enable it.

Pre-meeting checklist (please confirm):
- You and Sam can access the sandbox link: https://app.redwood.ai/sandbox/invite/OPR-0472
- You have one example product catalog (CSV or JSON) available to reference

If anything changes, reply here and I'll rebook. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Soojin
